  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nTARGET = \"LPN-GM-TR-014\"\nEXPECTED_REFERENCE = \"LPN-AIP-2025-09-24-03\"\nINITIAL_TIMESTAMP = \"2025-09-24T14:36:00Z\"\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    workspace = Path(ws)\n    return workspace.parent / \"system\" / \"maximo_transformer_registry\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef check_target_evidence_reference(ws):\n    try:\n        with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n            con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n            row = con.execute(\n                \"SELECT asset_evidence_reference FROM transformer_assets WHERE asset_id = ?\",\n                (TARGET,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            logs = con.execute(\n                \"SELECT approved_by FROM asset_evidence_update_log WHERE asset_id = ? AND asset_evidence_reference = ?\",\n                (TARGET, EXPECTED_REFERENCE),\n            ).fetchall()\n        if row is None:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Target asset not ).fetchall()\n        if len(rows) != 1:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Expected exactly one evidence-update audit row overall, found {len(rows)}.\"}\n        row = rows[0]\n        expected = (TARGET, \"ENG-DGA-2025-014-R2\", EXPECTED_REFERENCE, INITIAL_TIMESTAMP)\n        actual = (row[\"asset_id\"], row[\"previous_evidence_reference\"], row[\"asset_evidence_reference\"], return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Exactly one authorized, concurrency-protected update is recorded.\"}\n    except Exception as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Audit check failed: {exc}\"}\n\n\ndef check_priority_asset_preservation(ws):\n    other_refs = {\n        \"LPN-GM-TR-027\": \"ENG-DGA-2025-027-R1\",\n        \"LPN-GM-TR-031\": \"ENG-THM-2025-031\",\n        \"LPN-GM-TR-044\": \"ENG-DGA-2025-044-R3\",\n        \"LPN-GM-TR-052\": \"ENG-DGA-2025-052-R1\",\n    }\n    technical = {\n        \"site_id\": \"LPN-SITE-BAT\", \"asset_name\": \"T1\", \"serial_number\": \"BRU-78-44192\",\n        \"commissioned_date\": \"1978-06-14\", \"mva_rating\": 20.0, \"voltage_class_kv\": 33.0,\n        \"asset_class\": \"HV_DISTRIBUTION_TRANSFORMER\", \"mounting_type\": \"GROUND\",\n        \"asset_status\": \"ACTIVE\", \"manufacturer\": \"Brush Transformers\", \"model_number\": \"HDT-20/33\",\n    }\n    try:\n        with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n            con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n            for asset_id, reference in other_refs.items():\n                row = con.execute(\"SELECT asset_evidence_reference FROM transformer_assets WHERE asset_id = ?\", (asset_id,)).fetchone()\n                if row is None or row[\"asset_evidence_reference\"] != reference:\n                    return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Priority asset {asset_id} was changed.\"}\n            row = con.execute(\"SELECT \" + \",\".join(technical) + \" FROM transformer_assets WHERE asset_id = ?\", (TARGET,)).fetchone()\n
